alt: A phone screen displaying a call log with multiple missed calls from "Healthcare" and subsequent Google search results for the associated phone number, revealing contact details for L.A. Care Health Plan.
summary: The video demonstrates a user investigating a series of missed calls from a contact labeled "Healthcare" on their mobile phone. The call log shows numerous missed calls from the same Los Angeles-based number (+1 213-694-1250) over several days in late March and early April. The user then utilizes a phone feature to look up the number, which initiates a Google search. The search results identify the number as belonging to the L.A. Care Health Plan, a public agency providing health coverage for low-income residents in Los Angeles County. The search results provide comprehensive contact details, including the organization's main office address, 24/7 operating hours for member services, and a detailed list of specific phone numbers for various plan types (Medi-Cal, L.A. Care Covered/Direct, Medicare Plus, PASC-SEIU). Additionally, the results include contact information for several support lines, such as a 24-hour nurse advice line, enrollment support, mental health services, and a compliance/fraud hotline, along with the mailing address for formal correspondence. The video highlights the utility of phone features and search engines in identifying unknown callers and obtaining detailed organizational contact information.
